run.machines: Lambda Cloud us-south-2: m1-m4 NVIDIA Quadro RTX 6000 24 GB, m5 RTX A6000 48 GB; Ubuntu 22.04; one private network
run.ollama: 0.40.16, OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=4 in its systemd unit, nothing else changed
run.workload: about 1,250 prompt and 200 completion tokens per chat request
run.telemetry: off on every router and node
run.harness: scripts/benchmark.py from OSS main (per-request records, in-band errors and drained requests counted as failures, rates over the load phase)

failure.what: 4 machines, 8 concurrent qwen3-coder:30b for 240 s; Ollama stopped on m3, then herd-node killed with -9 and Ollama stopped on m4 (events: seconds from the run clock's zero; kill times from the operator's log, to the second)

events.what: killed herd-node -9 and stopped Ollama on m4 (machine gone)

identical_machines.what: one model on four identical machines, 8 concurrent, 120 s

mixed_fleet.what: m1, m2 (24 GB) and m5 (48 GB); qwen3-coder:30b, qwen2.5:14b-instruct-q8_0, phi4:14b-q8_0 and qwen2.5:32b-instruct-q8_0 (35 GB, only m5 has it and can hold it), model chosen at random per request, open loop for 180 s, client timeout 300 s; start state m1 coder, m2 qwen2.5:14b, m5 the 32b

herd.router: 1e7cdb2 (both placement fixes; the code released as 0.12.11)

herd_seed7.router: 1e7cdb2 (both placement fixes; the code released as 0.12.11)

herd_seed8.router: 1e7cdb2 (both placement fixes; the code released as 0.12.11)

one_large_vs_two_small.what: one RTX A6000 48 GB against two Quadro RTX 6000 24 GB, same router; mix = qwen3-coder:30b, qwen3.5:9b and nomic-embed-text, 4 workers each, 180 s

vision.what: qwen3-coder:30b, nomic-embed-text and moondream (an image question per request), 4 workers each, 180 s; one RTX 6000 with all three loaded, against m1, m2 and m5
